newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange trade quieter, prices rise.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange trade quieter, prices rise.

text.p: Volume fell to 495 kilos on the Istanbul gold exchange on Thursday from the previous 700 kilos as physical demand eased after mid-week bullion deliveries by jewellers to the state mint, dealers said.

Gold's dollar price was little changed at $369.80 an ounce against $369.70 on Wednesday, while lira prices rose to 1,260,500 lira per gram from previous 1,253,750, in line with the lira's slide against the dollar.
Traders say physical demand in the free gold market usually eases after jewellers' bullion deliveries to the state mint by Wednesday midday, at the latest.
There was 345 kilos of trade in the morning session and 150 kilos in the afternoon. 58.6 percent of trade was conducted in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-275 08 75
